Per-individual marker depth

Source: R/marker_table.R
depth.Rd

Per-individual marker depth

Usage

depth(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'marker_table'
depth(x, popmap, ...)

Arguments

x

A marker_table.

...

Passed to rsx_depth().

popmap

Population map path.

Value

A tibble of per-individual depths.

Examples

# \donttest{
mt <- marker_table("markers.tsv")
#> Error: marker_table: file does not exist: markers.tsv
depth(mt, popmap = "popmap.tsv")
#> Error: object 'mt' not found
# }
